entities.name: Nadhmi Auchi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Nadhmi Shakir Auchi, is a British-Iraqi businessman and billionaire, founding president of the Anglo Arab Organisation, and the founder and chairman of General Mediterranean Holding (GMH), a conglomerate of 120 companies worldwide.
